strings.book_subtitle: what the panel does, one screen at a time.
strings.vol1_sub: getting in, your folders, the panic key, the room.
strings.vol2_sub: flashes, videos, subliminals, the spiral, sound.

strings.vol4_sub: the parts of the app that talk back. pages to come.
strings.vol5_sub: the heavier rooms, written down once they hold still.
strings.vol6_sub: what the app remembers, and what that earns you.
